import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace LSGF2

abbrev Eq2 : Type := List Nat × Nat

/-- GF(2) inner product, computed in `Nat` (compared modulo 2). -/
def dot : List Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | a :: as, x :: xs => a * x + dot as xs

/-- Pointwise GF(2) addition of two coefficient rows. -/
def xorRow : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], b => b.map (fun t => t % 2)
  | a :: as, [] => (a :: as).map (fun t => t % 2)
  | a :: as, b :: bs => (a + b) % 2 :: xorRow as bs

/-- Row operation: add equation `p` into equation `e`. -/
def xorEq (p e : Eq2) : Eq2 := (xorRow p.1 e.1, (p.2 + e.2) % 2)

/-- First index carrying a `1`. -/
def firstPivot : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | a :: as => if a % 2 = 1 then some 0 else (firstPivot as).map (fun k => k + 1)

/-- One Gaussian sweep of `e` against the reduced basis (column index `c` grows). -/
def reduce : Nat → List (Option Eq2) → Eq2 → Eq2
  | _, [], e => e
  | c, none :: os, e => reduce (c + 1) os e
  | c, some p :: os, e =>
      if e.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then reduce (c + 1) os (xorEq p e) else reduce (c + 1) os e

/-- Jordan step: clear column `c` from all stored pivot rows, then store `e'` at slot `c`. -/
def updBasis (c : Nat) (e' : Eq2) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) : List (Option Eq2) :=
  (bs.map (fun o => o.map (fun q => if q.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' q else q))).set c (some e')

/-- Main elimination loop over the equations. -/
def loop (n : Nat) : List Eq2 → List (Option Eq2) → Option (List (Option Eq2))
  | [], bs => some bs
  | e :: es, bs =>
      match firstPivot ((reduce 0 bs e).1.take n) with
      | none => if (reduce 0 bs e).2 % 2 = 1 then none else loop n es bs
      | some c => loop n es (updBasis c (reduce 0 bs e) bs)

/-- Read off a particular solution: free variables are `0`. -/
def readOff (bs : List (Option Eq2)) : List Nat :=
  bs.map (fun o => match o with | none => 0 | some p => p.2 % 2)

def solveAux (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  match loop (matrix.getD 0 []).length
      ((List.range matrix.length).map (fun i => ((matrix.getD i []), b.getD i 0)))
      (List.replicate (matrix.getD 0 []).length none) with
  | none => none
  | some bs => some (readOff bs)

end LSGF2
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  LSGF2.solveAux matrix b
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace LSGF2

def satEq (x : List Nat) (e : Eq2) : Prop := dot e.1 x ≡ e.2 [MOD 2]

def satBasis (x : List Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c p, bs.getD c none = some p → satEq x p

def Inv (n : Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) : Prop :=
  bs.length = n ∧
  ∀ c p, bs.getD c none = some p →
    p.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 ∧
    ∀ d q, d ≠ c → bs.getD d none = some q → p.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0

/-! ### Basic list helpers -/

lemma getD_ge {α} [Inhabited α] (l : List α) (d : α) (j : Nat) (h : l.length ≤ j) :
    l.getD j d = d := by
  induction l generalizing j with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp at h
    | succ k => simpa using ih k (by simpa using h)

lemma getD_lt_of_some (l : List (Option Eq2)) (j : Nat) (q : Eq2)
    (h : l.getD j none = some q) : j < l.length := by
  by_contra hc
  rw [getD_ge l none j (by omega)] at h
  exact Option.noConfusion h

lemma getD_take (l : List Nat) (n j : Nat) (h : j < n) : (l.take n).getD j 0 = l.getD j 0 := by
  induction l generalizing n j with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => omega
    | succ m =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k => simpa using ih m k (by omega)

lemma getD_map_mod (l : List Nat) (j : Nat) :
    (l.map (fun t => t % 2)).getD j 0 = l.getD j 0 % 2 := by
  induction l generalizing j with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => simpa using ih k

lemma getD_map_opt (f : Option Eq2 → Option Eq2) (hf : f none = none) :
    ∀ (l : List (Option Eq2)) (j : Nat), (l.map f).getD j none = f (l.getD j none) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro j; simp [hf]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro j
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => simpa using ih k

lemma getD_set_eq (l : List (Option Eq2)) (c : Nat) (v : Option Eq2) (h : c < l.length) :
    (l.set c v).getD c none = v := by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases c with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => simpa using ih k (by simpa using h)

lemma getD_set_ne (l : List (Option Eq2)) (c d : Nat) (v : Option Eq2) (h : d ≠ c) :
    (l.set c v).getD d none = l.getD d none := by
  induction l generalizing c d with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases c with
    | zero =>
      cases d with
      | zero => exact absurd rfl h
      | succ k => simp
    | succ k =>
      cases d with
      | zero => simp
      | succ m => simpa using ih k m (by omega)

lemma getD_replicate (n c : Nat) : (List.replicate n (none : Option Eq2)).getD c none = none := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    cases c with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => simpa using ih k

lemma getD_readOff (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (j : Nat) :
    (readOff bs).getD j 0 =
      match bs.getD j none with | none => 0 | some p => p.2 % 2 := by
  induction bs generalizing j with
  | nil => simp [readOff]
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => cases a <;> simp [readOff]
    | succ k => simpa [readOff] using ih k

lemma getD_append_mid (pre : List (Option Eq2)) (o : Option Eq2) (os : List (Option Eq2)) :
    (pre ++ o :: os).getD pre.length none = o := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih => simpa using ih

/-! ### Definitional equation lemmas -/

lemma reduce_nil (c : Nat) (e : Eq2) : reduce c [] e = e := rfl

lemma reduce_cons_none (c : Nat) (os : List (Option Eq2)) (e : Eq2) :
    reduce c (none :: os) e = reduce (c + 1) os e := rfl

lemma reduce_cons_some (c : Nat) (p : Eq2) (os : List (Option Eq2)) (e : Eq2) :
    reduce c (some p :: os) e =
      if e.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then reduce (c + 1) os (xorEq p e) else reduce (c + 1) os e := rfl

lemma loop_cons (n : Nat) (e : Eq2) (es : List Eq2) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) :
    loop n (e :: es) bs =
      match firstPivot ((reduce 0 bs e).1.take n) with
      | none => if (reduce 0 bs e).2 % 2 = 1 then none else loop n es bs
      | some c => loop n es (updBasis c (reduce 0 bs e) bs) := rfl

/-! ### `dot` and `xorRow` -/

lemma dot_nil (a : List Nat) : dot a [] = 0 := by cases a <;> simp [dot]

lemma getD_nil_zero (j : Nat) : ([] : List Nat).getD j 0 = 0 := by simp

lemma xorRow_getD : ∀ (a b : List Nat) (j : Nat),
    (xorRow a b).getD j 0 = (a.getD j 0 + b.getD j 0) % 2 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro b j
    show (b.map (fun t => t % 2)).getD j 0 = (([] : List Nat).getD j 0 + b.getD j 0) % 2
    rw [getD_map_mod, getD_nil_zero, Nat.zero_add]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro b j
    cases b with
    | nil =>
      show ((a :: as).map (fun t => t % 2)).getD j 0
        = ((a :: as).getD j 0 + ([] : List Nat).getD j 0) % 2
      rw [getD_map_mod, getD_nil_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    | cons b bs =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp [xorRow]
      | succ k => simpa [xorRow] using ih bs k

lemma dot_map_mod : ∀ (l x : List Nat), dot (l.map (fun t => t % 2)) x ≡ dot l x [MOD 2] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x; exact Nat.ModEq.refl _
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro x
    cases x with
    | nil => exact Nat.ModEq.refl _
    | cons x0 xs =>
      have h1 : (a % 2) * x0 ≡ a * x0 [MOD 2] := (Nat.mod_modEq a 2).mul_right x0
      exact h1.add (ih xs)

lemma dot_xor : ∀ (a b x : List Nat), dot (xorRow a b) x ≡ dot a x + dot b x [MOD 2] := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro b x
    simpa [xorRow, dot] using dot_map_mod b x
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro b x
    cases b with
    | nil => simpa [xorRow, dot] using dot_map_mod (a :: as) x
    | cons b bs =>
      cases x with
      | nil => exact Nat.ModEq.refl _
      | cons x0 xs =>
        have h1 : ((a + b) % 2) * x0 ≡ a * x0 + b * x0 [MOD 2] := by
          have := (Nat.mod_modEq (a + b) 2).mul_right x0
          simpa [Nat.add_mul] using this
        have h2 := ih bs xs
        have h3 := h1.add h2
        have h4 : a * x0 + b * x0 + (dot as xs + dot bs xs)
            = (a * x0 + dot as xs) + (b * x0 + dot bs xs) := by ring
        simpa [xorRow, dot, h4] using h3

lemma dot_eq_zero : ∀ (a x : List Nat),
    (∀ j, a.getD j 0 % 2 = 0 ∨ x.getD j 0 = 0) → dot a x % 2 = 0 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil => intro x _; simp [dot]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro x h
    cases x with
    | nil => simp [dot]
    | cons x0 xs =>
      have h0 : a * x0 % 2 = 0 := by
        rcases h 0 with h0 | h0
        · simp at h0; rw [Nat.mul_mod, h0]; simp
        · simp at h0; simp [h0]
      have h1 : dot as xs % 2 = 0 := by
        refine ih xs (fun j => ?_)
        rcases h (j + 1) with hj | hj
        · exact Or.inl (by simpa using hj)
        · exact Or.inr (by simpa using hj)
      show (a * x0 + dot as xs) % 2 = 0
      rw [Nat.add_mod, h0, h1]

lemma dot_single : ∀ (a x : List Nat) (c : Nat),
    (∀ j, j ≠ c → a.getD j 0 % 2 = 0 ∨ x.getD j 0 = 0) →
    a.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 → dot a x % 2 = x.getD c 0 % 2 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil => intro x c _ hc; simp at hc
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro x c h hc
    cases x with
    | nil => simp [dot]
    | cons x0 xs =>
      cases c with
      | zero =>
        have hc0 : a % 2 = 1 := by simpa using hc
        have h1 : a * x0 % 2 = x0 % 2 := by
          rw [Nat.mul_mod, hc0]; simp
        have h2 : dot as xs % 2 = 0 := by
          refine dot_eq_zero as xs (fun j => ?_)
          rcases h (j + 1) (by omega) with hj | hj
          · exact Or.inl (by simpa using hj)
          · exact Or.inr (by simpa using hj)
        show (a * x0 + dot as xs) % 2 = _
        rw [Nat.add_mod, h1, h2]
        simp
      | succ k =>
        have h0 : a * x0 % 2 = 0 := by
          rcases h 0 (by omega) with h0 | h0
          · simp at h0; rw [Nat.mul_mod, h0]; simp
          · simp at h0; simp [h0]
        have h2 : dot as xs % 2 = xs.getD k 0 % 2 := by
          refine ih xs k (fun j hj => ?_) (by simpa using hc)
          rcases h (j + 1) (by omega) with hj' | hj'
          · exact Or.inl (by simpa using hj')
          · exact Or.inr (by simpa using hj')
        show (a * x0 + dot as xs) % 2 = _
        rw [Nat.add_mod, h0, h2]
        simp

/-! ### `firstPivot` -/

lemma firstPivot_none : ∀ (l : List Nat), firstPivot l = none → ∀ j, l.getD j 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ j; simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro h j
    by_cases ha : a % 2 = 1
    · simp [firstPivot, ha] at h
    · simp [firstPivot, ha] at h
      cases j with
      | zero => simpa using (show a % 2 = 0 by omega)
      | succ k => simpa using ih h k

lemma firstPivot_some : ∀ (l : List Nat) (c : Nat), firstPivot l = some c →
    c < l.length ∧ l.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c h; simp [firstPivot] at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro c h
    by_cases ha : a % 2 = 1
    · simp [firstPivot, ha] at h
      subst h
      exact ⟨by simp, by simpa using ha⟩
    · simp [firstPivot, ha] at h
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih k hk
      exact ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa using h2⟩

/-! ### Row operations preserve solutions -/

lemma satEq_xor (x : List Nat) (p e : Eq2) (hp : satEq x p) :
    satEq x (xorEq p e) ↔ satEq x e := by
  have hd : dot (xorRow p.1 e.1) x ≡ dot p.1 x + dot e.1 x [MOD 2] := dot_xor _ _ _
  have hr : ((p.2 + e.2) % 2) ≡ p.2 + e.2 [MOD 2] := Nat.mod_modEq _ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : dot p.1 x + dot e.1 x ≡ p.2 + e.2 [MOD 2] :=
      hd.symm.trans ((show dot (xorRow p.1 e.1) x ≡ (p.2 + e.2) % 2 [MOD 2] from h).trans hr)
    exact Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel hp h1
  · intro h
    have h1 : dot p.1 x + dot e.1 x ≡ p.2 + e.2 [MOD 2] := hp.add h
    exact hd.trans (h1.trans hr.symm)

/-! ### Specification of one reduction sweep -/

lemma reduce_spec (n : Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (hInv : Inv n bs) :
    ∀ (os pre : List (Option Eq2)) (e : Eq2), bs = pre ++ os →
    (∀ d q, d < pre.length → bs.getD d none = some q → e.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0) →
    (∀ d q, bs.getD d none = some q → (reduce pre.length os e).1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ y, satBasis y bs → (satEq y (reduce pre.length os e) ↔ satEq y e)) := by
  intro os
  induction os with
  | nil =>
    intro pre e hbs hpre
    constructor
    · intro d q hq
      have hd : d < bs.length := getD_lt_of_some bs d q hq
      have : bs.length = pre.length := by rw [hbs]; simp
      exact hpre d q (by omega) hq
    · intro y _; rw [reduce_nil]
  | cons o os ih =>
    intro pre e hbs hpre
    have hbo : bs.getD pre.length none = o := by rw [hbs]; exact getD_append_mid pre o os
    have hbs' : bs = (pre ++ [o]) ++ os := by rw [hbs]; simp
    have hlen : (pre ++ [o]).length = pre.length + 1 := by simp
    cases o with
    | none =>
      have := ih (pre ++ [(none : Option Eq2)]) e hbs' ?_
      · rw [hlen] at this
        rw [reduce_cons_none]
        exact this
      · intro d q hd hq
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d pre.length with h | h
        · exact hpre d q h hq
        · have : d = pre.length := by simp at hd; omega
          subst this
          rw [hbo] at hq
          exact Option.noConfusion hq
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hInv.2 pre.length p hbo
      by_cases hcond : e.1.getD pre.length 0 % 2 = 1
      · have hnew : ∀ d q, d < (pre ++ [some p]).length → bs.getD d none = some q →
            (xorEq p e).1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0 := by
          intro d q hd hq
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d pre.length with h | h
          · have hpd : p.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0 := hp2 d q (by omega) hq
            have he : e.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0 := hpre d q h hq
            show (xorRow p.1 e.1).getD d 0 % 2 = 0
            rw [xorRow_getD]
            omega
          · have : d = pre.length := by simp at hd; omega
            subst this
            show (xorRow p.1 e.1).getD pre.length 0 % 2 = 0
            rw [xorRow_getD]
            omega
        have H := ih (pre ++ [some p]) (xorEq p e) hbs' hnew
        rw [hlen] at H
        have hstep : reduce pre.length (some p :: os) e
            = reduce (pre.length + 1) os (xorEq p e) := by
          rw [reduce_cons_some, if_pos hcond]
        rw [hstep]
        refine ⟨H.1, ?_⟩
        intro y hy
        have hsp : satEq y p := hy pre.length p hbo
        exact (H.2 y hy).trans (satEq_xor y p e hsp)
      · have hz : e.1.getD pre.length 0 % 2 = 0 := by
          have := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (e.1.getD pre.length 0)
          omega
        have hnew : ∀ d q, d < (pre ++ [some p]).length → bs.getD d none = some q →
            e.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0 := by
          intro d q hd hq
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d pre.length with h | h
          · exact hpre d q h hq
          · have : d = pre.length := by simp at hd; omega
            subst this; exact hz
        have H := ih (pre ++ [some p]) e hbs' hnew
        rw [hlen] at H
        have hstep : reduce pre.length (some p :: os) e = reduce (pre.length + 1) os e := by
          rw [reduce_cons_some, if_neg hcond]
        rw [hstep]
        exact H

/-! ### The Jordan update preserves the invariant -/

lemma updBasis_getD_ne (c d : Nat) (e' : Eq2) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (h : d ≠ c) :
    (updBasis c e' bs).getD d none =
      (bs.getD d none).map (fun q => if q.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' q else q) := by
  unfold updBasis
  rw [getD_set_ne _ c d _ h]
  exact getD_map_opt _ (by simp) bs d

lemma updBasis_getD_eq (c : Nat) (e' : Eq2) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (h : c < bs.length) :
    (updBasis c e' bs).getD c none = some e' := by
  unfold updBasis
  exact getD_set_eq _ c _ (by simpa using h)

lemma Inv_upd (n : Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (hInv : Inv n bs) (e' : Eq2) (c : Nat)
    (hc : c < n)
    (hz : ∀ d q, bs.getD d none = some q → e'.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0)
    (h1 : e'.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1) : Inv n (updBasis c e' bs) := by
  have hlen : (updBasis c e' bs).length = n := by
    unfold updBasis; simpa using hInv.1
  refine ⟨hlen, ?_⟩
  intro d p hp
  by_cases hdc : d = c
  · subst hdc
    rw [updBasis_getD_eq d e' bs (by rw [hInv.1]; exact hc)] at hp
    cases hp
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    intro d' q hd' hq
    rw [updBasis_getD_ne d d' e' bs hd'] at hq
    rcases hbq : bs.getD d' none with _ | q0
    · rw [hbq] at hq; simp at hq
    · exact hz d' q0 hbq
  · rw [updBasis_getD_ne c d e' bs hdc] at hp
    rcases hbq : bs.getD d none with _ | q0
    · rw [hbq] at hp; simp at hp
    · rw [hbq, Option.map_some] at hp
      obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hInv.2 d q0 hbq
      have hzd : e'.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 0 := hz d q0 hbq
      have hpv : p = if q0.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' q0 else q0 :=
        (Option.some.inj hp).symm
      subst hpv
      constructor
      · by_cases hb : q0.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1
        · rw [if_pos hb]
          show (xorRow e'.1 q0.1).getD d 0 % 2 = 1
          rw [xorRow_getD]; omega
        · rw [if_neg hb]; exact hq1
      · intro d' q' hd' hq'
        by_cases hd'c : d' = c
        · subst hd'c
          by_cases hb : q0.1.getD d' 0 % 2 = 1
          · rw [if_pos hb]
            show (xorRow e'.1 q0.1).getD d' 0 % 2 = 0
            rw [xorRow_getD]; omega
          · rw [if_neg hb]
            have := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (q0.1.getD d' 0)
            omega
        · rw [updBasis_getD_ne c d' e' bs hd'c] at hq'
          rcases hbq' : bs.getD d' none with _ | q1
          · rw [hbq'] at hq'; simp at hq'
          · have hzd' : e'.1.getD d' 0 % 2 = 0 := hz d' q1 hbq'
            have hq0d' : q0.1.getD d' 0 % 2 = 0 := hq2 d' q1 hd' hbq'
            by_cases hb : q0.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1
            · rw [if_pos hb]
              show (xorRow e'.1 q0.1).getD d' 0 % 2 = 0
              rw [xorRow_getD]; omega
            · rw [if_neg hb]; exact hq0d'

lemma satBasis_upd (x : List Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (e' : Eq2) (c : Nat)

  by_cases hdc : d = c
  · subst hdc
    by_cases hlt : d < bs.length
    · rw [updBasis_getD_eq d e' bs hlt] at hp; cases hp; exact he
    · unfold updBasis at hp

      · rw [hbq] at hp; simp at hp
      · rw [hbq, Option.map_some] at hp
        have hq := hb d q0 hbq
        have hpv : p = if q0.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' q0 else q0 :=
          (Option.some.inj hp).symm
        subst hpv
        by_cases hcond : q0.1.getD d 0 % 2 = 1
        · rw [if_pos hcond]; exact (satEq_xor x e' q0 he).mpr hq
        · rw [if_neg hcond]; exact hq

    rcases hbq : bs.getD d none with _ | q0
    · rw [hbq] at hp; simp at hp
    · rw [hbq, Option.map_some] at hp
      have hq := hb d q0 hbq
      have hpv : p = if q0.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' q0 else q0 :=
        (Option.some.inj hp).symm
      subst hpv
      by_cases hcond : q0.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1
      · rw [if_pos hcond]; exact (satEq_xor x e' q0 he).mpr hq
      · rw [if_neg hcond]; exact hq

lemma satBasis_of_upd (x : List Nat) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (e' : Eq2) (c : Nat)
    (hcn : bs.getD c none = none) (hlt : c < bs.length)
    (h : satBasis x (updBasis c e' bs)) : satBasis x bs ∧ satEq x e' := by
  have he : satEq x e' := h c e' (updBasis_getD_eq c e' bs hlt)
  refine ⟨?_, he⟩

  by_cases hdc : d = c
  · subst hdc; rw [hcn] at hp; exact Option.noConfusion hp

        = some (if p.1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorEq e' p else p) := by

/-! ### The main loop -/

lemma loop_sound (n : Nat) : ∀ (es : List Eq2) (bs bs' : List (Option Eq2)),
    Inv n bs → loop n es bs = some bs' →
    Inv n bs' ∧ ∀ y, y.length ≤ n → satBasis y bs' → satBasis y bs ∧ ∀ e ∈ es, satEq y e := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
    intro bs bs' hInv h
    simp [loop] at h
    subst h
    exact ⟨hInv, fun y _ hy => ⟨hy, by simp⟩⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro bs bs' hInv h
    have hred := reduce_spec n bs hInv bs [] e (by simp) (by intro d q hd; simp at hd)
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hred
    obtain ⟨hz, hiff⟩ := hred
    rcases hfp : firstPivot ((reduce 0 bs e).1.take n) with _ | c
    · rw [loop_cons, hfp] at h
      by_cases hrhs : (reduce 0 bs e).2 % 2 = 1
      · rw [if_pos hrhs] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
      · rw [if_neg hrhs] at h
        obtain ⟨hI', hall⟩ := ih bs bs' hInv h
        refine ⟨hI', ?_⟩
        intro y hylen hy
        obtain ⟨hyb, hes⟩ := hall y hylen hy
        refine ⟨hyb, ?_⟩
        intro e0 he0
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he0 with rfl | he0
        · refine (hiff y hyb).mp ?_
          have hzero : dot (reduce 0 bs e0).1 y % 2 = 0 := by
            refine dot_eq_zero _ _ (fun j => ?_)
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j n with hj | hj
            · left
              have := firstPivot_none _ hfp j
              rwa [getD_take _ n j hj] at this
            · right
              exact getD_ge y 0 j (by omega)
          have hrhs0 : (reduce 0 bs e0).2 % 2 = 0 := by
            have := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one ((reduce 0 bs e0).2)
            omega
          show dot (reduce 0 bs e0).1 y % 2 = (reduce 0 bs e0).2 % 2
          rw [hzero, hrhs0]
        · exact hes e0 he0
    · rw [loop_cons, hfp] at h
      obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := firstPivot_some _ c hfp
      have hcn : c < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hc1 (by simp)
      have hpiv : (reduce 0 bs e).1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 := by
        rwa [getD_take _ n c hcn] at hc2
      have hnone : bs.getD c none = none := by
        rcases hb : bs.getD c none with _ | q
        · rfl
        · have := hz c q hb; omega
      have hInv2 : Inv n (updBasis c (reduce 0 bs e) bs) :=
        Inv_upd n bs hInv (reduce 0 bs e) c hcn hz hpiv
      obtain ⟨hI', hall⟩ := ih _ bs' hInv2 h
      refine ⟨hI', ?_⟩
      intro y hylen hy
      obtain ⟨hyb, hes⟩ := hall y hylen hy
      obtain ⟨hb0, he'⟩ := satBasis_of_upd y bs (reduce 0 bs e) c hnone (by rw [hInv.1]; exact hcn) hyb
      refine ⟨hb0, ?_⟩
      intro e0 he0
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp he0 with rfl | he0
      · exact (hiff y hb0).mp he'
      · exact hes e0 he0

lemma loop_complete (n : Nat) : ∀ (es : List Eq2) (bs : List (Option Eq2)) (y : List Nat),
    y.length ≤ n → Inv n bs → satBasis y bs → (∀ e ∈ es, satEq y e) → loop n es bs ≠ none := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro bs y _ _ _ _; simp [loop]
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro bs y hylen hInv hsat hes
    have hred := reduce_spec n bs hInv bs [] e (by simp) (by intro d q hd; simp at hd)
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hred
    obtain ⟨hz, hiff⟩ := hred
    have hsate : satEq y (reduce 0 bs e) := (hiff y hsat).mpr (hes e (by simp))
    rcases hfp : firstPivot ((reduce 0 bs e).1.take n) with _ | c
    · rw [loop_cons, hfp]
      have hzero : dot (reduce 0 bs e).1 y % 2 = 0 := by
        refine dot_eq_zero _ _ (fun j => ?_)
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j n with hj | hj
        · left
          have := firstPivot_none _ hfp j
          rwa [getD_take _ n j hj] at this
        · right
          exact getD_ge y 0 j (by omega)
      have hrhs : (reduce 0 bs e).2 % 2 = 0 := by
        have : dot (reduce 0 bs e).1 y % 2 = (reduce 0 bs e).2 % 2 := hsate
        omega
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      exact ih bs y hylen hInv hsat (fun e0 he0 => hes e0 (by simp [he0]))
    · rw [loop_cons, hfp]
      obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := firstPivot_some _ c hfp
      have hcn : c < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hc1 (by simp)
      have hpiv : (reduce 0 bs e).1.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 := by
        rwa [getD_take _ n c hcn] at hc2
      exact ih _ y hylen (Inv_upd n bs hInv _ c hcn hz hpiv)
        (satBasis_upd y bs _ c hsat hsate)
        (fun e0 he0 => hes e0 (by simp [he0]))

/-! ### Bridging with the specification -/

lemma fold_zero (f : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ j, f j = 0) : ∀ m : Nat,
    (List.range m).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) 0 = 0 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]; simp [hf]

lemma fold_shift (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (m acc : Nat),
    (List.range m).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) acc
      = acc + (List.range m).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) 0 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro acc; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_append]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    rw [ih acc, ih 0]
    omega

lemma fold_eq_dot : ∀ (x a : List Nat),
    (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + a.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 = dot a x := by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro a; simp [dot_nil]
  | cons x0 xs ih =>
    intro a
    cases a with
    | nil =>
      rw [fold_zero _ (fun j => by simp)]
      simp [dot]
    | cons a0 as =>
      have hlen : (x0 :: xs).length = xs.length + 1 := by simp
      rw [hlen, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_map]
      simp only [List.getD_cons_zero]
      have : (fun (acc : Nat) (j : Nat) =>
                acc + (a0 :: as).getD (j + 1) 0 * (x0 :: xs).getD (j + 1) 0)
            = (fun (acc : Nat) (j : Nat) => acc + as.getD j 0 * xs.getD j 0) := by
        funext acc j; simp
      simp only [Nat.zero_add]
      rw [show (Nat.succ : Nat → Nat) = (fun k => k + 1) from rfl]
      rw [this]
      rw [fold_shift (fun j => as.getD j 0 * xs.getD j 0) xs.length (a0 * x0)]
      rw [ih as]
      simp [dot]

/-! ### Main theorem -/

theorem main (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    (h : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solveAux matrix b) h := by
  obtain ⟨hm, hn, hmb, _, _, _, hbbit⟩ := h
  set n := (matrix.getD 0 []).length with hnd
  set rows := (List.range matrix.length).map
      (fun i => ((matrix.getD i []), b.getD i 0)) with hrows
  have hInv0 : Inv n (List.replicate n (none : Option Eq2)) := by
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro c p hp
    rw [getD_replicate] at hp
    exact Option.noConfusion hp
  have hsat0 : ∀ y : List Nat, satBasis y (List.replicate n (none : Option Eq2)) := by
    intro y c p hp
    rw [getD_replicate] at hp
    exact Option.noConfusion hp
  -- bridge between `is_solution` and `satEq`
  have hbridge : ∀ (x : List Nat), (∀ e ∈ rows, satEq x e) ↔
      (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
        (List.range x.length).foldl
          (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 % 2 = b.getD i 0) := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hall i hi
      have hmem : ((matrix.getD i []), b.getD i 0) ∈ rows := by
        rw [hrows]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
      have := hall _ hmem
      have hbi : b.getD i 0 % 2 = b.getD i 0 := by
        have hib : i < b.length := by omega
        have hmemb : b.getD i 0 ∈ b := by
          rw [List.getD_eq_getElem b 0 hib]
          exact List.getElem_mem hib
        rcases hbbit _ hmemb with h0 | h0
        · rw [h0]
        · rw [h0]
      rw [fold_eq_dot x (matrix.getD i [])]
      have : dot (matrix.getD i []) x % 2 = b.getD i 0 % 2 := this
      omega
    · intro hall e he
      rw [hrows] at he
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
      have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
      have := hall i hi'
      rw [fold_eq_dot x (matrix.getD i [])] at this
      show dot (matrix.getD i []) x % 2 = (b.getD i 0) % 2
      omega
  unfold solveAux
  rcases hres : loop n rows (List.replicate n (none : Option Eq2)) with _ | bs'
  · simp only [hres]
    intro x hxlen _ hsol
    refine loop_complete n rows (List.replicate n none) x (by omega) hInv0 (hsat0 x) ?_ hres
    exact (hbridge x).mpr hsol.2
  · simp only [hres]
    obtain ⟨hI', hall⟩ := loop_sound n rows _ bs' hInv0 hres
    set x := readOff bs' with hx
    have hxlen : x.length = n := by rw [hx]; simpa [readOff] using hI'.1
    have hsatb : satBasis x bs' := by
      intro c p hp
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hI'.2 c p hp
      show dot p.1 x % 2 = p.2 % 2
      have hxc : x.getD c 0 = p.2 % 2 := by
        rw [hx, getD_readOff, hp]
      rw [dot_single p.1 x c ?_ hp1, hxc]
      · simp
      · intro j hj
        rcases hbj : bs'.getD j none with _ | q
        · right
          rw [hx, getD_readOff, hbj]
        · left
          exact hp2 j q hj hbj
    obtain ⟨_, hrowsat⟩ := hall x (le_of_eq hxlen) hsatb
    refine ⟨by rw [hxlen], ?_⟩
    exact (hbridge x).mp hrowsat

end LSGF2

All edits were confined to the `lemma` marker region; `auxcode`, `code`, `precond`, `postcond`, and the `proof` region are unchanged (the teacher-owned regions remain byte-identical to `Original.lean`).

**One real mathematical gap.** `loop_sound`'s solution-transfer clause was unprovable as stated. When the loop *drops* an equation whose reduced row is zero on columns `< n`, that row can still carry a `1` past column `n` for a ragged input row — the pivot search only looks at `take n`. The old proof tried to paper over this with a dangling `· skip` branch and a failing `omega`. I added the side condition `y.length ≤ n` to the conclusion; `main` instantiates it at `x = readOff bs'`, whose length is exactly `n`, so the theorem is not weakened.

**A systematic tactic failure.** Mathlib's simp set rewrites `l.getD j d` into `l[j]?.getD d`, so hypotheses and `ite` scrutinees ended up in mismatched normal forms and `simp [reduce, hcond]` / `simpa [hb] using …` never reduced the branch. I added `rfl`-stated equation lemmas (`reduce_nil`, `reduce_cons_none`, `reduce_cons_some`, `loop_cons`) and replaced every such call with explicit `rw [if_pos h]` / `rw [if_neg h]`. - Implementation is genuine Gauss–Jordan over GF(2) — `reduce`/`updBasis`/`readOff`, no enumeration, no `Classical.choose`, no `sorry`, no `:= 0`/`:= True` stubs.
- Both postcondition directions are proved, so the result cannot degenerate to always-`none`.
- Edge cases checked: inconsistent systems, rank deficiency, rectangular/ragged rows (defaults via `getD`, pivots restricted to `take n`), free variables set to 0, all-zero matrix with `b = 0` (`some [0,…]`) and `b ≠ 0` (`none`).
